distribution: Official project publications in Maven Central and official Debian security OpenJDK package
acquisition: Fetch each exact coordinate URL recorded in java-native-maven.json using ordinary HTTPS requests to Maven Central.
Compare each JAR with the published checksum at the recorded URL. Some publishers supply SHA1 only; every local file additionally has an enforced SHA256 pin.
Place the SpotBugs runtime JARs under kit/lib and the FindSecBugs plugin under kit/plugin. Keeping the plugin outside the baseline classpath makes producer attribution observable.

Download the exact Debian package identified below, verify its full byte count and SHA256 before parsing, and select the reviewed regular members listed by archive_member in java-native-pins.json. Materialize symlink target bytes only from explicit regular archive members. Preserve runtime/debian-copyright. Never execute package scripts or install a system package.
Validate every runtime and JAR byte count and SHA256 against the pinned manifest before execution. No mutable system runtime path is used by the integration.
Exclude host-generated cacerts: these disconnected owned controls perform no TLS. AppCDS images remain excluded and execution uses -Xshare:off. No runtime bytes come from the host Java installation.

owned_program.compiler: runtime/bin/java -Xshare:off -Xmx512m -m jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main -g -d classes src/OwnedSafe.java src/OwnedUnsafe.java src/OwnedWitness.java
owned_program.compiled_output: Four class files, including the witness's nested Capture class; all bytecode hashes are pinned.
owned_program.witness: Executes owned null handling and captures JDBC calls through memory-only Java dynamic proxies. It opens no database connection.

native_analysis.plugin: Repeat the same analysis with -pluginList plugin/findsecbugs-plugin-1.14.0.jar.
native_analysis.attribution: Require baseline diagnostics to remain identical and require exactly the additional native SQL_INJECTION_JDBC finding from FindSecBugs.
native_analysis.clean_control: Require native ClassStats to include OwnedSafe with zero findings in both analyses, and reject missing classes or analysis errors.

isolation.environment: HOME, TMPDIR, PATH and LC_ALL only; HOME and TMPDIR use the private temporary directory.
isolation.scope: Only the three pinned owned Java sources are compiled. Only two owned classes are analyzed. Only the owned witness is executed.

observed_setup_issues: GitHub release downloads were blocked specifically at https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com:443. Official Maven Central publications were accessible; no escalation was requested.
The initial direct dependency set lacked BCEL's commons-io dependency. Reading the published POMs identified the exact transitive coordinates; adding the pinned dependencies resolved native startup.

The previous host runtime lacked package-manager provenance. Rebuilding from Debian openjdk-21-jre-headless 21.0.13+9-1~deb13u2 reproduced 176 selected runtime files exactly. The host-generated cacerts file was excluded; the original package copyright was added unchanged.
not_claimed: Independent source-rebuilt analyzer binaries or signed Maven provenance verification.
A complete dependency license review or a closed inventory of host shared libraries.
A general precision benchmark, real database vulnerability discovery, or proof that arbitrary Java code is safe.

runtime_package.name: openjdk-21-jre-headless
runtime_package.checksum_listing_note: The package listing tracks the latest version. The version-specific archive URL and SHA256 above identify the reviewed publication.

portability.requires: Linux x86-64 with compatible host shared libraries, CPython 3.12 and unprivileged user/network namespaces
